gaps.explanation: Business-type detail holds only the Schedule 7 (p15) budgetary-cash-basis fund totals: Sewer receipts 121,105 and Water receipts 45,592 (indexes 48, 49) = 166,697. Sewer's 121,105 includes the 98,624 transfer from other funds and is on another basis than the statement. The statement lines come from Exhibit H (p8, accrual, Sewer Fund / Water Fund columns), whose fund columns are not in detail. Replace the two budget lines with the p8 column lines: Sewer Utility collections 22,065 + Interest income 165 = 22,230; Water Utility collections 44,882 + Deposits, hookup fees 25 + Interest income 18 = 44,925. 166,697 - 166,697 + 67,155 = 67,155 = statement (Total operating revenues 66,972 + Interest income 183, p8). The Sewer Fund Transfers from other funds 98,624 (p8) is a business-type transfer, not added here (no gap row).

The statement lines are the Exhibit H (p8) accrual operating expenses 94,169. Replace them with the p8 Sewer Fund / Water Fund column lines: Sewer 25,242 + 1,180 + 828 + 235 + 9,542 = 37,027; Water 25,242 + 1,075 + 17,067 + 560 + 3,952 + 9,246 = 57,142. 173,003 - 173,003 + 94,169 = 94,169 = statement Total operating expenses 94,169 (p8).
